title: A CMOS Dual-Switching Power-Supply Modulator with 8% Efficiency Improvement for 20MHz LTE Envelope Tracking RF Power Amplifiers Muhammad Hassan1, Peter M. Asbeck1, Lawrence E. Larson2
figure_number: Figure 21.3.2 shows the detailed schematic of the new supply modulator. All three amplifiers use 3.3 V stacked devices for reliable operation with a 5.5V power supply. The linear stage output current is scaled down by a 250:1 ratio current mirror M1’-M4’ and then converted into voltage using a trans-impedance amplifier, across which a hysteretic comparator is placed to generate the control signal for the hysteretic switching stage. design_purpose: In this paper, we propose an improved dual-switch topology based on multi-level control, as shown in Fig. 21.3.1, where the first switching amplifier uses large devices, a 1μH inductor, is hysteretically controlled, provides a low-pass response and roughly 60% of the LTE envelope power.
